question: In which of the following states are the Abor hills located?
solution:
The correct answer is __** ****Arunachal Pradesh** __

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Abor Hills** is a region of **Arunachal Pradesh** in the far northeast of India, near the** border with China.** 
 
• The hills are bordered by the** Mishmi Hills and Miri Hill**s and drained by the** Dibang river**, a** tributary of the Brahmaputra.**
 
• The Abor Hills are a tract of country on the northeast frontier of India, which was occupied by an independent tribe, the Adi people, formerly called the Abors.
 
• The Abors are tribal people in the state of Arunachal Pradesh.
 
• During the British Raj, the hills had a reputation as a troublesome area, and military expeditions were sent against the residents in the **1890s**
 
• The region was administered as the Abor Hills District from** 1948**, with headquarters at Pasighat, but later reorganized into the **Lower Dibang** Valley and Lohit districts.
